phase: Accounting Empirical Recovery / F4 Phase A — Loans Coverage Audit
purpose: Determine exact ECB QSA who-to-whom coverage and maturity coverage for the RMD F4 holder-by-issuer matrix before materialization.

source_orientations.domestic_holder_asset: W2; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=issuer; entry=A
source_orientations.domestic_issuer_liability: W2; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=holder; entry=L
source_orientations.resident_holder_to_X: W1; reference sector=holder; counterpart sector=S1; entry=A
source_orientations.X_holder_to_resident_issuer: W1; reference sector=issuer; counterpart sector=S1; entry=L

maturity_rule.exact_fallback: S + L only when both short- and long-term series are available on identical dimensions
maturity_rule.control: when T, S and L are all available, T must reconcile to S+L within 0.1 million RON

promotion_rule: A later F4 materialization gate may proceed only for cells that are directly observed or exactly derived from S+L and/or S12-S121, with no orientation conflict and with all available aggregate controls passing. This phase only records coverage.
system_dynamics_conformity: Accounting-only recovery. No behavioural feedback, delay, nonlinearity or closure status may change.
